实验：探究加速度与力、质量的关系: Experiment: How Acceleration Depends on Force and Mass
不直接测力、也不直接测加速度——一张纸带加几个槽码，能不能把 a 与 F、m 的: Without measuring force or acceleration directly, can one paper tape and a few hanging weights reveal how a depends on F and m?
垫高木板，重力沿板分量抵消摩擦：点距变等距（Δx = 0.00 mm）: Raise the board so the component of gravity along it cancels friction: dot spacing becomes uniform (Δx = 0.00 mm)
先通电、后放车，纸带记下 4 段间距 x₁…x₄: Power on first, then release the cart; the tape records 4 spacings x₁…x₄
间距 → 速度 vₙ → v–t 图斜率 = a: Spacing → velocity vₙ → slope of v–t graph = a
只改槽码个数（a–F）／只改车上砝码块（a–1/m）: Change only the number of hanging weights (a–F) / only the blocks on the cart (a–1/m)
两条过原点的直线：a ∝ F、a ∝ 1/m；斜率是 1/m 与 F: Two straight lines through the origin: a ∝ F, a ∝ 1/m; slopes are 1/m and F
一端带滑轮的长木板、垫块、细线: Long board with a pulley at one end, a wedge block, string
小车、车上砝码块、竖直悬挂的槽码: Cart, blocks on the cart, hanging slotted weights
电磁打点计时器、纸带、刻度尺: Electromagnetic ticker timer, paper tape, ruler
桌上这些器材各干什么？靠打点计时器那一端为什么要垫起来？: What is each piece of equipment on the bench for? Why is the timer end of the board raised?
拖视角绕实验台看一圈：顺细线走完「槽码 → 滑轮 → 小车 → 纸带 → 打点计: Drag the view around the bench and follow the string: "weights → pulley → cart → tape → ticker timer"
默认工况：F = 0.29 N、m = 0.360 kg、a = 0.81 m/: Default setup: F = 0.29 N, m = 0.360 kg, a = 0.81 m/s²; a block raises the timer end (the angle sign reads "raised 1.15°"); the 4 tape spacings are 44.03 / 52.08 / 60.14 / 68.19 mm.
本实验用槽码的重力当拉力（教材 p.88「小车所受的拉力可认为与槽码所受的重力相: This experiment uses the weight of the hanging masses as the pulling force (textbook p.88: "the pull on the cart can be taken as equal to the weight of the hanging masses"), the tape to find acceleration (p.89, method 2), and a balance to weigh the mass (p.89). The setup is reference case 1 in Fig. 4.2-2.
器材认得出：长木板一端垫高、滑轮在低的那一端、打点计时器在高的那一端、纸带从小车: Recognize the equipment: one end of the board is raised, the pulley is at the low end, the timer is at the high end, and the tape passes through the guide hole from the back of the cart.
三个量各有各的测法：质量用天平、拉力用槽码重力、加速度用纸带。: Each quantity has its own method: mass by balance, force by the hanging weight, acceleration by the tape.
教材 p.89 旁注问「用测力计手拉行不行」——不行：手保证不了大小和方向恒定，: A margin note on p.89 asks "could you pull with a spring scale by hand?" No: a hand can't keep the size and direction constant, nor keep it parallel to the board.
去掉这一步：学生不知道哪个数是「测出来的」、哪个是「算出来的」。: Skip this step and students can't tell which numbers are "measured" and which are "calculated".
器材辨认是必做实验的第一项能力（课标 p.13「会使用基本的力学实验器材获取数据: Identifying equipment is the first skill of a required experiment (curriculum standard p.13: "use basic mechanics equipment to obtain data").
F = m_h·g，m 由天平读，a 由纸带求: F = m_h·g, m read from the balance, a from the tape
为什么要把木板一端垫高？垫到什么程度算「平衡好了」？垫过头会怎样？: Why raise one end of the board? How high counts as "balanced"? What if it's raised too far?
槽码已取下、小车轻推了一下：把「垫高木板」拨到开，看纸带点距变等距: Weights removed, cart given a light push: switch "Raise board" on and watch the dot spacing become uniform
不挂槽码、轻推一下的三个快照：木板水平 → a = −0.20 m/s²（减速，: Three snapshots with no weights and a light push: board level → a = −0.20 m/s² (slowing, Δx = −1.96 mm, dots get closer); raised 1.15° → a = 0.00 m/s², Δx = 0.00 mm (uniform spacing); raised too far (2.29°) → a = +0.20 m/s² (speeds up by itself, Δx = +1.96 mm).
平衡阻力就是让重力沿木板的分量正好抵消摩擦（教材 p.90「使小车在不受牵引时能: Balancing friction means the component of gravity along the board exactly cancels friction (textbook p.90: "so the cart, without being pulled, drags the tape down the board at constant speed"). The test is uniform dot spacing, not "just prop it up". Raising it too far adds a spurious μ·g = 0.196 m/s².
facts A2.14、A4.1、A7.1；图4.2-2（p.90）；标准值表: facts A2.14, A4.1, A7.1; Fig. 4.2-2 (p.90); standard values table D
平衡阻力要「不挂槽码 + 拖着纸带 + 能匀速」三个条件同时满足——只垫不挂纸带: Balancing friction needs three conditions at once: no weights + dragging the tape + constant speed. Prop it up without the tape and the tape's friction isn't included, so it isn't balanced.
判据是纸带点距均匀（Δx = 0.00 mm），不是「垫了个东西」。: The test is uniform dot spacing (Δx = 0.00 mm), not "something is under it".
垫过头会凭空多出 μ·g = 0.196 m/s²，这一点第 7 步还要用。: Raising too far adds a spurious μ·g = 0.196 m/s²; step 7 uses this again.
去掉这一步：后面每一条图线都带着 −0.196 m/s² 的平移，学生发现不了。: Skip this step and every later graph carries a −0.196 m/s² offset that students won't notice.
必考：平衡阻力的做法与判据；「拖着纸带」这一步为什么不能省。: Exam must-know: how to balance friction and how to check it; why "dragging the tape" can't be skipped.
先接电源还是先放小车？顺序错了，纸带上会少掉什么？: Power on first, or release the cart first? In the wrong order, what's missing from the tape?
槽码挂回了 4 个：把打点计时器电源拨到接通，再看纸带上的点: 4 weights hung back on: switch the timer power on, then look at the dots on the tape
通电后纸带 4 段 = 44.03 / 52.08 / 60.14 / 68.1: With power on, the 4 spacings are 44.03 / 52.08 / 60.14 / 68.19 mm and the first dot marks where the cart starts moving. Release first and power on later, and the first 0.10 s of tape is blank ≈ 40 mm (= v₀·T): usable spacings drop from 4 to 3 and velocity points from 3 to 2. With the power off, the main reading, Δx and v all show "—" (not 0).
教材 p.37「把小车停在靠近打点计时器的位置。启动计时器，然后放开小车……随后: Textbook p.37: "Stop the cart near the timer. Start the timer, then release the cart… then switch off the power at once." The timer uses 50 Hz AC, one dot every 0.02 s, so "four dots not shown between counting points" means a counting interval of 0.1 s.
顺序是「先接通电源、再放开小车」，最后「立即断电源」。: The order is "power on, then release the cart", and finally "switch off at once".
50 Hz → 0.02 s 一点；「每两个计数点间有四个点未画出」→ T =: 50 Hz → one dot per 0.02 s; "four dots not shown between counting points" → T = 0.1 s (not 0.02 s).
顺序错了的后果有数：开头空白 0.10 s ≈ 40 mm，可用间距 4 段 →: The wrong order has a measurable cost: 0.10 s ≈ 40 mm blank at the start; usable spacings 4 → 3, velocity points 3 → 2.
去掉这一步：学生直接拿到「一条已经打好的纸带」，不知道它为什么可信、也不知道顺序: Skip this step and students just get "a finished tape" without knowing why it can be trusted or what the wrong order would do.
必考：操作顺序与「为什么」；「每两个计数点间四个点未画出」意味着 T = 0.1: Exam must-know: the procedure order and why; "four dots not shown between counting points" means T = 0.1 s.
交流 50 Hz · 每两个计数点间 4 个点未画出: AC 50 Hz · 4 dots not shown between counting points
一条纸带怎么变成一个 a？为什么不直接用 a = 2x/t²？: How does one tape become one value of a? Why not just use a = 2x/t²?
盯住坐标纸板上的 v–t 图（3 个点 + 过点直线）和 Δx 读数: Watch the v–t graph on the graph board (3 points + fitted line) and the Δx reading
Default setup: x₁…x₄ = 44.03 / 52.08 / 60.14 / 68.19 mm → v₁ = 0.4806, v₂ = 0.5611, v₃ = 0.6417 m/s (successive differences 0.0805 / 0.0806 = a·T); Δx = 8.06 mm; slope of v–t line = a = 0.81 m/s².
相邻间距差恒定 ⟹ 匀加速；vₙ = (xₙ + xₙ₊₁)/(2T)（教材 p: A constant difference between successive spacings ⟹ uniform acceleration; vₙ = (xₙ + xₙ₊₁)/(2T) (textbook pp.23–24: "use the average velocity over this interval as the instantaneous velocity at a point within it"), and the slope through the three points is a (data analysis box, p.37). The dense dots at the start were discarded, so the starting speed v₀ = 0.40 m/s ≠ 0, which is why a = 2x/t² can't be used.
facts A2.7、A2.18、A2.21、A3.3、A5.3；图4.2-6（: facts A2.7, A2.18, A2.21, A3.3, A5.3; Fig. 4.2-6 (p.93), Table 1 (p.37); standard values table A1
相邻间距的「差」恒定才说明是匀加速；间距本身不恒定没有关系。: It's the constant *difference* between spacings that shows uniform acceleration; the spacings themselves needn't be constant.
速度用前后两段的平均给中间那个点（教材 p.23–24「间隔越小越接近」）。: Velocity at a point is the average over the segments on either side (textbook pp.23–24: "the shorter the interval, the closer").
a 是 v–t 图的斜率，不是某个间距除以时间。: a is the slope of the v–t graph, not one spacing divided by a time.
Work through the tape in Fig. 4.2-6 yourself: 6.19 / 6.70 / 7.21 / 7.72 cm, T = 0.1 s → Δx = 0.51 cm → a = 0.51 m/s².
必考：由纸带求加速度（v–t 图斜率 / 逐差法）；「a = 2x/t² 要求初: Exam must-know: finding acceleration from a tape (v–t slope / successive differences); the condition that a = 2x/t² requires zero initial speed.
小车质量不变，多挂一个槽码，a 会变多少？五个点画出来是什么形状？: With the cart's mass fixed, how much does a change when you add one weight? What shape do five points make?
m 固定在 0.360 kg，把槽码从 1 个换到 5 个，每换一档点一次「记录: Fix m at 0.360 kg, change the weights from 1 to 5, and press "Record" at each setting
m = 0.360 kg 固定，槽码 1→5 个：F = 0.14 / 0.19: m = 0.360 kg fixed, weights 1→5: F = 0.14 / 0.19 / 0.24 / 0.29 / 0.34 N, a = 0.39 / 0.53 / 0.67 / 0.81 / 0.94 m/s². The five points lie on a line through the origin with slope k_F = 2.781 kg⁻¹ → m_meas = 1/k_F = 0.360 kg, matching the balance.
控制变量：只改拉力时 a ∝ F；a–F 图线过原点（教材 p.91「如果这些点: Controlled variables: changing only the force gives a ∝ F; the a–F line passes through the origin (textbook p.91: "if the points lie near a straight line through the origin, a is proportional to F"), and its slope is 1/m. These five values match textbook Table 4 digit for digit. The 0.67 cell is blank in the textbook as an exercise (a = F/m gives exactly 0.67; it's the answer, not a printed value).
facts A2.2、A2.3、A2.6、A5.2；图4.2-2（p.90）、表: facts A2.2, A2.3, A2.6, A5.2; Fig. 4.2-2 (p.90), Table 4 (p.93); standard values tables B, G
控制变量：这一步只准动槽码个数，车上砝码块一块都不许动。: Controlled variables: in this step change only the number of hanging weights; don't touch the blocks on the cart.
五个点要落在过原点的直线上，斜率就是 1/m（2.781 → 0.360 kg: The five points should lie on a line through the origin whose slope is 1/m (2.781 → 0.360 kg = balance reading).
点是「记录一组」存下来的，不是纸上自己画的——记 4–5 组就够。: Points are stored with "Record", not drawn by hand; 4–5 sets are enough.
去掉这一步：a ∝ F 就成了背下来的结论，学生没有证据。: Skip this step and a ∝ F becomes a memorized conclusion with no evidence.
必考：由 a–F 图线过原点判断正比、由斜率求质量（教材 p.91）。: Exam must-know: judging proportionality from an a–F line through the origin, and finding mass from its slope (textbook p.91).
a = F / m（m 一定）· k_F = Σ(F·a)/ΣF²: a = F / m (m fixed) · k_F = Σ(F·a)/ΣF²
固定拉力，把 a 对 m 画出来能看出什么？为什么教材要改画 a–1/m？: With the force fixed, what does a graph of a against m show? Why does the textbook switch to a–1/m?
F 固定（4 个槽码 = 0.29 N），把车上砝码块从 0 块换到 4 块，每: Fix F (4 weights = 0.29 N), change the blocks on the cart from 0 to 4, press "Record" at each; then switch the x-axis to 1/m to see a line
F = 0.29 N 固定，m = 0.310 / 0.360 / 0.410: F = 0.29 N fixed, m = 0.310 / 0.360 / 0.410 / 0.610 / 0.860 kg → a = 0.94 / 0.81 / 0.71 / 0.48 / 0.34 m/s². Against m the points curve; switched to 1/m = 3.2258 / 2.7778 / 2.4390 / 1.6393 / 1.1628 kg⁻¹ the five points form a line through the origin with slope k_R = 0.292 N (≈ the constant force 0.29 N).
双曲线不能直接判反比（教材 p.91「我们很难直观看出图线是否为双曲线」）；换成: A hyperbola can't directly prove inverse proportion (textbook p.91: "it is hard to see by eye whether the graph is a hyperbola"); switch to a–1/m, and if it passes through the origin, a ∝ 1/m (textbook p.92). This step is the axis change from Fig. 4.2-4 → Fig. 4.2-5 → Fig. 4.2-7. These five values match textbook Table 5 digit for digit; the m = 0.31 kg cell is a blank exercise whose answer is 0.94 (not a printed value).
a–m 图是双曲线，不能直接说「成反比」——必须换轴。: The a–m graph is a hyperbola; you can't say "inversely proportional" from it. You must change axes.
换轴以后要求「过原点」，不是「看着像直线」。: After changing axes, require "through the origin", not just "looks straight".
这一步只准动车上砝码块，槽码个数一个都不许动。: In this step change only the blocks on the cart; don't touch the number of hanging weights.
教材表 6 是同一个规律的 8 组数据：a·m ≈ 0.157 N，a–1/m: Textbook Table 6 gives 8 sets for the same law: a·m ≈ 0.157 N, and a–1/m also passes through the origin (exercise 2).
必考：a–1/m 图像（教材 p.92；p.93 练习第 2 题就是画它）。: Exam must-know: the a–1/m graph (textbook p.92; exercise 2 on p.93 asks you to draw it).
如果木板没垫好，或者槽码太重，a–F 图线会长成什么样？两种毛病在图上的样子一样: If the board isn't raised right, or the weights are too heavy, what does the a–F line look like? Do the two faults look the same?
把「垫高木板」拨到关（未平衡阻力），看 a–F 图线还过不过原点: Switch "Raise board" off (friction not balanced) and see whether the a–F line still passes through the origin
① 未平衡（m = 0.360 kg，槽码 1→5 个）：a = 0.19 /: ① Not balanced (m = 0.360 kg, weights 1→5): a = 0.19 / 0.33 / 0.47 / 0.61 / 0.75 m/s²; the line misses the origin, crossing the a-axis at −0.196 m/s² and the F-axis at +0.0706 N. ② Raised too far: a = 0.58 / 0.72 / 0.86 / 1.00 / 1.14, crossing the a-axis at +0.196 and the F-axis at −0.0706 (signs reversed). ③ Real equipment: a = 0.38 / 0.50 / 0.62 / 0.74 / 0.86, 3.8 %–8.8 % below F/m, with the top of the line bending down; k_F = 2.569 → m_meas = 0.389 kg, 8.1 % above the balance's 0.360 kg.
截距的符号就能判状态：与 F 轴交于正半轴 = 摩擦没抵消（没平衡好）；与 a: The sign of the intercept tells the state: crossing the positive F-axis = friction not cancelled (not balanced); crossing the positive a-axis = raised too far. When the weights are not much lighter than the cart, the assumption F = m_h·g itself fails (textbook p.88 note: "the condition is that the hanging mass is much smaller than the cart's mass"), so the line bends at the top and the mass from the slope comes out too large.
facts A2.16, A7.2, A7.5; B2.1 items 12, 13; B1.5; standard values tables E, G
两种毛病在图上长得不一样：没平衡好 → 与 F 轴交于正半轴；垫过头 → 与 a: The two faults look different on the graph: not balanced → crosses the positive F-axis; raised too far → crosses the positive a-axis.
槽码太重 → 图线「弯曲」（不是平移），而且由斜率求出的质量偏大。: Weights too heavy → the line *bends* (not shifts), and the mass from the slope is too large.
三种毛病都能用一个数说清：截距 ∓0.196 m/s²、偏差 −7.6 %，不是: Each fault can be stated as a number: intercept ∓0.196 m/s², deviation −7.6 %. Error is not "luck".
去掉这一步：学生会把「测出来和算出来不一样」当成自己算错。: Skip this step and students will think "measured ≠ calculated" means they made a mistake.
实验素养：说出误差来源与方向（课标 p.13「知道实验存在误差」）。: Lab skills: state error sources and their direction (curriculum standard p.13: "know that experiments have errors").
只有槽码、纸带和一张坐标纸，能不能把小车质量测出来？: With only weights, a tape and graph paper, can you measure the cart's mass?
平好阻力、固定 m，换成不同槽码各点一次「记录一组」，记满 3 组以上，让过原点: With friction balanced and m fixed, press "Record" with different weights, collect at least 3 sets, and get the mass from the through-origin slope within 5 % of the balance
达标条件：① 「垫高木板」开且「垫过头」关；② 车上砝码块一路上不变；③ 记满: Pass conditions: ① "Raise board" on and "Too far" off; ② blocks on the cart unchanged throughout; ③ at least 3 sets recorded; ④ m_meas from the through-origin slope within 5 % of the balance. One valid solution: m = 0.360 kg with 1/2/3 weights → k_F = 2.790 kg⁻¹, m_meas = 0.358 kg, 0.6 % off (with 5 sets, k_F = 2.781, m_meas = 0.360 kg). With real equipment m_meas = 0.389 kg, 8.1 % high → fail.
没有新结论：把前七步连起来用一遍——控制变量（m 不变）+ 纸带测 a + 过原: No new conclusion: use the first seven steps together: controlled variables (m fixed) + tape for a + slope of the line through the origin = 1/m. This is the quantitative version of textbook p.91's "if the points lie near a straight line through the origin…".
facts A2.6、A7.5；B2.1 第 10 条、B3 第 6 条；标准值: facts A2.6, A7.5; B2.1 item 10, B3 item 6; standard values table G
先按 k_F ≈ 1/m 估一下斜率，再看记的组数够不够。: Estimate the slope as k_F ≈ 1/m first, then check you have enough sets.
要记就记同一个 m 的几组，换 m 会把斜率搞乱。: Record several sets with the same m; changing m will mess up the slope.
切到真实器材一定测不准——这不是你算错，是「槽码质量」这一项的系统误差。: Real equipment will always miss: that isn't a calculation mistake, it's the systematic error from the hanging mass.
没有新结论：把前七步的关系连起来用一遍就是考核。: No new conclusion: the assessment chains the earlier relationships together.
综合：控制变量 + 纸带测 a + 过原点斜率 = 1/m。: Synthesis: controlled variables + tape for a + through-origin slope = 1/m.
取下纸带量 x₁…x₄ 与 Δx（Δx = a·T²）: Remove the tape and measure x₁…x₄ and Δx (Δx = a·T²)
木板垫高 1.146°：重力沿板的分量正好抵消摩擦（tanθ₀ = μ）。: Board raised 1.146°: the component of gravity along the board exactly cancels friction (tanθ₀ = μ).
木板水平：摩擦没被抵消，同一拉力下 a 小 μ·g = 0.196 m/s²。: Board level: friction isn't cancelled, so for the same force a is lower by μ·g = 0.196 m/s².
a–F 散点（横轴 1/m 的图看坐标纸板）: a–F scatter (see the graph board for the 1/m axis)
不用天平，用 a–F 图测出小车质量: Find the cart's mass from the a–F graph, without a balance
平好阻力 → 固定 m → 记满 3 组以上 → 由过原点斜率求 m_测，与天平: Balance friction → fix m → record at least 3 sets → find m_meas from the through-origin slope, within 5 % of the balance
刚称过的小车总质量: Total mass of the cart just weighed
平衡阻力时要「不挂槽码、拖着纸带、轻推后匀速」，「拖着纸带」这一步不能省，原因是: To balance friction you need "no weights, drag the tape, constant speed after a push". "Drag the tape" can't be skipped because
纸带太重，会拖住小车: The tape is heavy and holds the cart back
纸带与限位孔之间也有摩擦，要一起平衡掉: The tape rubs in the guide hole, and that friction must be balanced too
不放纸带就打不出点: Without the tape no dots are printed
阻力里包含纸带与限位孔的摩擦；只有「拖着纸带」时调好的倾角，正式实验才仍然对。: Resistance includes friction between the tape and the guide hole; only an angle set while dragging the tape stays correct in the real run.
交流 50 Hz、每两个计数点间有四个点未画出，两个计数点的时间间隔是: With 50 Hz AC and four dots not shown between counting points, the time between two counting points is
0.02 s × 5 个间隔 = 0.1 s（教材 p.93 练习第 2 题的条: 0.02 s × 5 intervals = 0.1 s (the condition in exercise 2 on p.93).
判断 a 与 m 是否成反比，应该看: To decide whether a is inversely proportional to m, look at
a–m 图是不是双曲线: Whether the a–m graph is a hyperbola
a–m 图是不是直线: Whether the a–m graph is a straight line
a–1/m 图是不是过原点的直线: Whether the a–1/m graph is a line through the origin
a 与 m 的乘积变不变: Whether the product a·m stays constant
教材 p.91–92：a–m 图是双曲线时看不出是不是反比，改作 a–1/m 图: Textbook pp.91–92: a hyperbola on the a–m graph can't show inverse proportion; plot a–1/m instead, and only a line through the origin proves it.
没平衡阻力就做实验，a–F 图线: Doing the experiment without balancing friction, the a–F line
仍过原点，只是斜率变小: Still passes through the origin, just with a smaller slope
a = F/m − μ·g：F 要大于 μ·m·g 车才动，所以图线与 F 轴交: a = F/m − μ·g: F must exceed μ·m·g before the cart moves, so the line crosses the positive F-axis (+0.0706 N in this lesson).
用一张纸带、几个槽码，把 a 与 F、m 的关系量出来，并说出误差偏在哪边。: With one paper tape and a few hanging weights, measure how a depends on F and m, and say which way the errors go.
